name: Haverford Township Full Day Summer Camp (ECP)
street_address: Community Recreation & Environmental Center (CREC), 9000 Parkview Drive
description_short: Full day township camp for Haverford Township residents ages 6 to 12, held at Manoa Elementary School with after care at the township's CREC. Days mix sports, games and crafts with bowling every Thursday, field trips every Friday and occasional swim trips; only township residents can register.
notes: 2026: June 22 to August 7, weekly registration, 9:00 to 3:00 at Manoa Elementary School (location subject to change), extended care 8:00 to 9:00 and 3:00 to 6:00, with campers bused to the CREC at 3:00. Residents only; registration opened March 2, 2026. Fees not posted on the camp page. Snack provided, campers bring lunch. 8 to 1 camper to counselor ratio.
